description:
Final v2.0.0 publish. Executes only after T-010c (matrix verdict green on §24 items 1–7) AND T-010d (packaging verdict green on §24 items 8–9) AND explicit user approval to tag and publish.

In scope (binding):
- Bump package.json version to 2.0.0 (and any helper crate version that mirrors it, if such a coupling exists in the repo — verify before editing).
- Update CHANGELOG / release notes capturing the architectural shift away from MediaRecorder. Required content:
  - The v1.1.0 → v2.0.0 transition: PipeWire capture, hardware encoder backend matrix (N-004), rolling fMP4 segment buffer (N-005), instant-replay export/remux pipeline (N-006), Electron ↔ helper IPC contract (N-007).
  - Headline: "v2 cleared the v1.1.0 1440p60 / 4K60 ceiling" with the v1.1.0 vs v2.0.0 comparison data from T-010c (N-008 §21). Numbers come from the matrix run, not narrative.
  - Issue #1 (crop area selection) marked resolved — absorbed by N-003 region capture mode and the app-owned overlay (N-007 region UX).
  - Issue #3 (source does not record until hovered) marked resolved — absorbed by `capture.sessionReady` being the only entry to RECORDING (N-007 FSM §22).
  - Issue #2 (replay keybind not configurable) confirmed addressed — either by v1.1.1 (T-002) or absorbed into v2 hotkeys (N-007 settings surface).
  - Issue #4 (crop/replay timer state weirdness) confirmed addressed — either by v1.1.1 (T-002) or absorbed into the three-clocks design and HUD-non-freeze guarantee (N-007 §22; VAL-UI-003 / VAL-UI-004).
  - Known limitations: video-only GA (audio milestone follows); Linux-first (Windows path documented but not shipped); 4K60 libx264 may back-pressure (acceptable per N-008 §6.1); AMF / WGC inert in v2.0.0 (visibly so per VAL-ENC-012).
  - Diagnostics bundle policy and how users file reports (engine.copyDiagnosticsBundle).
- Mark Issues #1 and #3 resolved in the storybloq issue tracker. Confirm Issues #2 and #4 are addressed (resolved if v1.1.1 shipped; resolved-by-absorption otherwise).
- Cut the v2.0.0 tag. Push. Publish artifacts (AppImage, .deb, Setup.exe placeholder per T-010d) along with their .sha256 sidecars.
- Verify the auto-update mechanism picks up the new version cleanly per N-007 §17 (sha256 check at boot covers integrity after update).

Gate (hard, binding):
- T-010c report shows §24 items 1–7 green. Any must-pass red blocks. A regression red at 1080p60 against v1.1.0 (per N-008 §21 discipline) blocks even if absolute thresholds are met.
- T-010d report shows §24 items 8–9 green. Any artifact missing a .sha256 sidecar blocks.
- User explicitly approves before tag, push, or publish per CLAUDE.md ("Do not build, package, release, publish, tag, or commit anything unless I explicitly ask").

Out of scope (binding):
- Re-running the matrix (T-010c) or repackaging (T-010d). If a gate is red, stop and route the fix back to the owner_on_fail layer per N-008 §3, then re-open T-010c / T-010d, then re-open T-010e. Do not paper over a red.
- Any source changes to the helper or Electron app. If the matrix or packaging audit found a defect, the fix is a separate ticket against the owner layer; T-010e does not patch.
- Borrowing release workflow from sibling projects per CLAUDE.md repo-boundary rule.
- Windows GA. v2.0.0 Linux-first per N-008 §4.
- Audio in the GA changelog beyond "audio milestone to follow".

Acceptance:
- v2.0.0 tag exists on origin.
- All shipped artifacts have matching .sha256 sidecars uploaded to the release.
- CHANGELOG / release notes reflect the matrix output; numbers traceable to T-010c's report.
- Issues #1 and #3 marked resolved; #2 and #4 confirmed addressed.
- N-008 §24 item 10 (release notes generated from matrix output) green.
- A post-release checklist in the handover lists any nice-to-have reds carried as tracked post-GA storybloq issues.

No commits, tags, or publishes without explicit user request. This ticket's first action is to confirm the user wants to ship.
title: v2.0.0 release: publish (version bump, CHANGELOG, tag, push, sidecar artifacts)
